title: phi-core TaskContract (DRAFT 0.1, engineering protocol only, NOT frozen)
description: Structural format of a task contract T. Passing this schema only means the document is structurally well-formed. It does NOT mean the task is feasible, and it does NOT mean final acceptance has passed.

contract_version.description: Draft protocol version. Only '0.1-draft' is currently accepted.

objective.description: Human-readable statement of what the task is meant to achieve.

required_evidence.description: Kinds of evidence the contract author expects to be supplied. Semantics are undecided.

metadata.description: Free-form, non-normative metadata. Ignored by validation semantics.

kind.description: Provisional label. 'hard' / 'soft' carry NO priority or evaluation semantics in this phase.
